scopeReview: CED FUN-5.A.3: behavior of accumulation functions from graphical, numerical, analytical and verbal integrand representations. FTC connects sign of f to monotonicity of g and slope of f to concavity; global comparisons include all endpoints and derivative-zero candidates. Original continuous line graphs have full descriptions; isolated zero, corner and no-concavity-change cases are justified separately.
varietyReview: Six original line graphs and an ordered derivative table. Relative and absolute extrema, reversed base, decreasing concave-up accumulation, first/second derivative column order, negative value with positive rate, horizontal nonturning tangent, nonstationary inflection at an integrand corner, common-base clipped area, even curvature zero and a later accumulation root. Exact geometric and algebraic arguments complement five direct graph/table computations.
